name: Gri'lek the Wanderer
notes: Numbers follow the Gri'lek section of docs/research/zul-gurub/edge-of-madness.md: 333,100 HP (Era), level 63, 20-man, no adds. Avatar lasts 15 s (DBM, DBC). No source gives its interval; the wiki says he spends about half the fight in it, so the script alternates 18 s of normal fighting with 15 s of Avatar, five times. That interval and the Ground Tremor and Entangling Roots cadences are estimates. Boss melee (340 per 2 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play and dies if the healer ignores a spike. Avatar: the table is wiped, he is immune to Taunt, hits five times harder and lumbers (at -75% speed) after a random player while everyone keeps clear. The tank does not hold him: the `avatarBackOff` debuff walks the tank to the Back off spot for the 15 s, scores any press of Taunt in that time, and the shrink wipes the table a second time so the tank has to take him back. The engine has no taunt immunity, so Taunt at the shrink stands in for rebuilding threat, and `turnGrace` is 16 s so the 15 s he is deliberately off the tank does not count as losing him. His speed is 5 all fight to stand in for the slow pursuit (the engine cannot change it mid-fight). Avatar's damage is the engine's `enrage` with a 15 s `duration`; the multiplier is 3, not the real 6, a tuned placeholder so the ghost tank survives it. In the non-tank roles the ghost tank has no taunt immunity to respect: it Taunts him back after 2.5 s and leads him to the Back off spot. A periodic melee-range `aoe` is the part the melee have to walk out of. The fixate and pursuit are only a tip and a target debuff on a random player (playerChance 0.35). Entangling Roots is a Magic debuff that stuns the player for 2 s (the engine has no root, so it also stops casting, which a real root does not). Ground Tremor is an `aoe` with a 2 s stun to everyone within 20 yd; the tank is stunned by this too, which is real. Sweeping Strikes is not modelled.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Tank him between Avatars. When he grows, the table wipes and he is taunt-immune: back off and keep clear for 15 s, then pick him up when he shrinks. (Here Taunt stands in for rebuilding threat.)

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Hit him between Avatars. When Avatar starts walk out of his reach and let his swing land before going back in. He is slower than you.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stay spread and over 20 yd from him so Ground Tremor misses you. Keep casting through Avatar and stop whenever the bar is red.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Dispel Entangling Roots the moment it lands on anyone he is chasing, and keep the tank up through every Avatar.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Every attack adds threat. Watch the bar: in the red band one more hit pulls the boss off the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A big heal on the tank. Have it landing as the spike hits, not after.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Removes the oldest dispellable debuff on the raid. One button here stands in for Dispel Magic, Cleanse, Decurse and Cure Poison.

groundTremor.label: Ground Tremor
groundTremor.tip: A 2 s stun on everyone within 20 yd.

entanglingRoots.label: Entangling Roots
entanglingRoots.tip: Roots a player and keeps ticking 219 every 3 s. Healers dispel it, the victim first if he is coming for them.

avatarWipe.label: Avatar: threat wiped
avatarWipe.tip: The table is wiped, he hits 5x as hard and slowly chases a random player. Scatter. Tanks back off.

avatarFrenzy.label: Avatar
avatarFrenzy.toast: Avatar: he hits five times harder
avatarFrenzy.tip: Avatar: +500% damage for 15 s. Do not be near him.

avatarBackOff.label: Avatar: back off
avatarBackOff.tip: He is immune to Taunt for 15 s and hits five times harder. Walk to the Back off spot and keep clear.

avatarFixate.label: Avatar fixates on you
avatarFixate.tip: He has you: run from him. Do not fight, he is far too slow to catch you.

avatarSwing.label: Avatar swing
avatarSwing.tip: Melee, walk out of his reach before this lands.

avatarEnds.label: Avatar fades: threat wiped
avatarEnds.toast: Avatar fades: the table is empty
avatarEnds.tip: He has shrunk and the table is empty. Tanks pick him up (here Taunt stands in for rebuilding threat).

expectations.label: Pull him to his spot
expectations.tip: Taunt him and walk him to the middle of the clearing.

expectations.label: Dispel Entangling Roots
expectations.tip: Roots on someone he is chasing is a death sentence. Dispel them first.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: When the threat bar is in the red band, stop attacking until the tank is clear again.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Keep the tank topped: the next Avatar is coming.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Healing the tank up is what the next Avatar demands.

expectations.label: Back off, do not try to hold him
expectations.tip: He is taunt-immune and hits five times harder. Walk away and wait for him to shrink.

expectations.label: Do not Taunt the Avatar
expectations.tip: He is immune to Taunt for the whole 15 s. Save it for when he shrinks.

expectations.label: Dispel the roots fast
expectations.tip: A rooted player cannot run from him.

expectations.tip: He hits 500% harder for 15 s. Walk out of his melee range and keep attacking only when the next swing has landed.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: In the red band one more hit can pull. Wait for the tank.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Every global you can safely use, use. Stop only when the bar is red or the boss is not on the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Nothing on the ground is worth a global. Step out, then carry on.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: A heal on a full tank is a heal you did not have for the spike.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

avatarHits.label: Avatar swings you stood in
avatarHits.tip: Walk out of his reach before the swing lands.

avatarTaunts.label: Taunts into the Avatar
avatarTaunts.tip: He is immune to Taunt for the whole 15 s. Back off and save it for when he shrinks.

cues.notes: Taunt when he shrinks (never during Avatar), Dispel the roots, Heal.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a spike coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

list.label: Taunt him back when the Avatar fades
list.tip: He has shrunk and the table is empty. Pick him up now.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Dispel the moment it lands. Tank first, then healers, then everyone else.

drills.name: Avatar: back off
drills.description: Every 30 s he becomes Avatar. Walk to the Back off spot and keep clear for 15 s without pressing Taunt, then Taunt him back when he shrinks.

drills.name: Stay out of Tremor
drills.description: Stay over 20 yd out, keep casting, stop when the bar is red.

drills.name: Roots and tank heals
drills.description: Dispel every Entangling Roots and keep the tank up through an Avatar.
